name: research-harness
description: ResearchStudio idea_spark on two tracks. Local: one Claude Code workflow replicating the upstream pipeline 1:1 — phase graph ported to JS, all 11 system prompts packed byte-for-byte, upstream's run.py for every deterministic step, and a differential test asserting the same next step as upstream's navigator on 52 fixtures. Web: a skill that drives the hosted IdeaSpark on chatgpt.com through the playwright extension, 1-5 conversations in parallel, seeded from a direction or from a finished local run, captured only when provably complete. Same judge scores both.
